fields.finding: A 270 GPa filament-derived axial tangent changes perfect linear multipliers, but the assumed taut, perfectly attached 0/90 skin has no qualified shear modulus, Poisson coupling, prestress, wrinkling, sagged equilibrium or free interior kinematics. The projected tangent can overstate restraint. No film-stiffness credit is used in primary resizing.
fields.needed: An actual gas-tight laminate, biaxial and shear constitutive data, tension-only/wrinkling treatment, pressure-equilibrated geometry, seams and attachments, plus tear, creep, fatigue and permeability evidence.
fields.prohibited_inference: Neither the fiber modulus nor the conditional pinned-film result proves a stable pressure vessel.
